data.name: Parasail
data.headline: Ages 5+ | Most Popular!
data.description: Soar up to 1,000 feet above Oahu’s south shore and enjoy incredible views of Diamond Head and the Pacific Ocean. Choose between 700, 850, 900, or 1,000 feet for your parasailing adventure. Fly tandem or triple, as we do not offer single rides for safety reasons. Enjoy a shared boat experience with up to 15 passengers. Observers are welcome to join the ride without parasailing.
data.highlights:
- Parasail up to 1,000 feet above Oahu’s south shore
- Enjoy incredible views of Diamond Head and the coastline
- Shared boat experience with up to 15 passengers
- Perfect for friends, families, and adventure seekers
data.itinerary:
- **Check-in:** Arrive 30 minutes prior to your tour at Slip F-1 in Kewalo Basin Harbor.
- **Boat Ride:** Enjoy a scenic boat ride before it’s your turn to parasail.
- **Parasail:** Fly up to 1,000 feet in the air, enjoying stunning views.
- **Post-Tour:** Return to the harbor after all guests have had their parasailing experience.

data.cancellation_summary: 48 hours notice required for up to 5 people; 72 hours for 6 or more people. Same-day cancellations are charged in full.
data.cancellation_notes:
X-treme Parasail requires all bookings to be paid for by credit card at the time of checkout. 
All sales are considered final.  
Cancellations for up to five people must be done at least 48 hours prior to your scheduled activity. Cancellations for six or more people must be done at least 72 hours prior to your scheduled activity. *ANY RESERVATIONS NOT CANCELLED WITHIN THE TERMS OF THIS POLICY WILL NOT BE REFUNDED. 
To cancel or reschedule, please contact (808) 737-3599 and speak with an agent. We are unable to answer your call if you call us during non-office hour. Please leave us an email or text from web live chat xtremeparasail.com for cancellation request if we do not answer your call. (voice mail n/a) 
SAME DAY CANCELLATIONS ARE A FULL CHARGE.
**RESCHEDULING OF ANY PORTION OF YOUR PARTY WILL RESULT IN A $10 PER PERSON/PER ACTIVITY FEE**

![Description of image](https://cdn.filestackcontent.com/mUjQUmhXTmuYjP2ebyBy)

#BOAT WILL DEPART AT YOUR BOOKING TIME 
#START CHECK-IN AT THE BOOTH ONCE YOU ARRIVE! 
# 1. All adults must sign their own waivers and the waivers for any minors in their care.
# 2. Get ticket from the agent at the window 
# 3. Please come wearing beach attire / apply sunscreen before getting on the boat
# 4. Wait for your boat to arrive next to our booth
data.booking_notes:
**YOU MUST READ ALL INFO BELOW PRIOR TO YOUR ACTIVITY!**


CHECK-IN **30 MINUTES** PRIOR TO YOUR ACTIVITY TIME 

**1025 ALA MOANA BLVD. SLIP F-1. 96815 AT THE XTREME PARASAIL BOOTH**
(LOCATED IN CORNER OF KEWALO BASIN HARBOR, NEARBY EXIT, JETSKI ON TOP OF BOOTH)

*PLEASE BE ADVISED THAT THE DLNR – DIVISION OF AQUATIC RESOURCES HAS IMPLEMENTED A REQUIRED FEE OF $1 PER PASSENGER FOR MARINE STEWARDSHIP PROGRAMS. THIS FEE IS NOT INCLUDED IN YOUR PAYMENT AND WILL BE COLLECTED UPON ARRIVAL. THE OCEAN STEWARDSHIP FEE PROGRAM IS REFERRED TO AS “ALOHA I KE KAI”, MEANING LOVE FOR OUR OCEAN. WE ASK FOR THIS FEE TO BE PAID IN CASH AS WE HAVE A MINIMUM CHARGE FOR CREDIT CARDS. MAHALO FOR YOUR PARTICIPATION IN AND SUPPORT OF HAWAI‘I’S OCEAN STEWARDSHIP. FOR MORE INFORMATION PLEASE VISIT [https://dlnr.hawaii.gov/alohaikekai/](https://dlnr.hawaii.gov/alohaikekai/).*

BOAT WILL DEPART AT YOUR BOOKING TIME ! Departure time is not guaranteed to be on-time depending on weather conditions that day. 

IF YOU ARE COMING BY CAR, PARKING IS LIMITED IN HARBOR SO PLEASE PLAN YOUR CHECK-IN EARLY AS POSSIBLE FOR YOUR DEPARTURE TIME. 



●　**IF YOU ARE LATE OR NO SHOW**

If you are no show or miss your boat you will still get charged the full amount, NO EXCEPTIONS. If you arrived 2 minutes later than your booking time you risk missing the boat and still being fully charged.  Boat will not wait for you even if you call us to let us know you are on the way. Please be on time, we don't want you to miss out on all this fun and still have to pay !! You can reschedule your booking to another time spot based on availability with $10/P. WE DO NOT WAIVE THIS FEE FOR ANY REASON. No refund will be processed for activity downgrade/changes that were made on a boat. 
**NO REFUND WILL PROCESS IF YOU ARE LATE TO YOUR BOOKING TIME FOR ANY REASONS**

It is your responsibility to CALL (7AM-6PM HST everyday, voice mail N/A), WEB LIVE CHAT or EMAIL us in order to make a note to request any changes to your booking! If you fail to leave a proof, cancellation policy will apply for any reason you may have.


●　**RESTRICTION**

ALL PARASAIL CUSTOMERS MUST BE 5 YEARS AND OLDER
PREGNANT WOMEN CANNOT RIDE ON THE BOAT OR PARASAIL.
NON-PARASAILER ON A BOAT WILL COUNT AS AN OBSERVER FOR ANY AGE. PLEASE CALL US OR TEXT US FROM xtremeparasail.com TO ADD AN OBSERVER $50/P TO YOUR BOOKING IF YOU ARE PLANNING TO BRING ANYONE ON A BOAT (Non-parasailer include baby, child and adult with any age). 
IF YOU HAVE ANY MINOR WHO NEED ADULT TO BE AROUND, PLEASE MAKE SURE TO HAVE SOMEONE IN YOUR PARTY TO WATCH YOUR CHILD. WE DO NOT FLY SINGLE FOR ANY SPECIAL REASON FOR YOUR SAFETY

450lbs is the general maximum for almost any weather we have for tandem parasail rides. However, if we have good enough weather we can fly up to 650lbs for two or three people. Weather is subject to change so we are unable to guarantee being able to do over 450 or triple rides, but most days we are able to accommodate it. Departure time is not guaranteed to be on-time depending on weather conditions that day. 

*Accommodating extra passengers not on the booking is not guaranteed*


●　**Parasail ride**

All pricing online is per person. 
If you bought a ticket for 1 parasailer, it is for 1 single person. 
Activity will start from a boat ride and you will take turns with others on the same boat for parasail tours. Parasail is usually a tandem ride, or triple ride. We do not guarantee triple ride, and we do not offer a single ride due to weight and balance for your safety. 
Your combination of the ride will be decided on the boat by our captain and crew depending on weather conditions. 
Boat Capacity:  up to 15 people

We operate with 1-2 boats every hour. If any of your group booked separately with different name, it is your responsibility to CALL (7AM-6PM HST everyday, voice mail N/A), WEB LIVE CHAT or EMAIL us in order to be in the same boat for your whole group.
Activity will take approximately 1 hour and 30 mins including a wait time for departure.

●　PARKING

PARKING IS LOCATED DIRECTLY ACROSS FROM OUR BOOTH. (OPPOSITE SIDE FROM FOOD TRUCK) PARKING SPACE IS LIMITED. PLEASE PAY FOR THE PARKING FEE BY PHONE IF YOU ARE PARKING INSIDE OF PARKING LOT. WE WILL NOT BE RESPONSIBLE IF YOU ARE LATE TO DEPARTURE/BOOKING TIME FOR ANY REASONS. 
PLEASE DO NOT PARK IN YELLOW/RED STALL BY ANY COMPANY BOOTH IN KEWALO BASIN HARBOR. 



It is your responsibility to CALL (7AM-6PM everyday, voice mail N/A), WEB LIVE CHAT or EMAIL us in order to make a note to request any changes to your booking!. If you failed to leave a proof, cancellation policy will apply for any reason you may have.


●　**Weather Cancellation**
As soon as we receive a weather cancellation announcement by xtreme parasail captains, we will call, text, or email you to inform you. Reschedule is possible for only limited openings we have at that time or you can also choose to get a full refund. WE DO NOT call you to let you know to not cancel your booking when weather doesn't seem perfect on your booking day. We cannot control or guarantee weather on your booking day. Mahalo for your understanding! 

PHOTO PAC PURCHASE: PURCHASE AVAILABLE ON BOAT BY CREW
NO locker or storage for your belongings in the harbor. Compartment under the seating area on the boat. 
Swimsuit, board shorts, rash guard, or any clothes you feel comfortable getting wet. We provide a life jacket.

-------------------------------------------------------------------------

data.restrictions:
Pregnant women cannot parasail or ride the boat.
- No single parasailing rides are offered for safety reasons.
- Weather conditions may impact the ability to fly triple or exceed 450 lbs for tandem rides.
data.faqs:
- **What should I wear?**
  - Wear a swimsuit, board shorts, or rash guard, and be prepared to get wet.

- **Can I bring my child under 5?**
  - No, children under 5 years old are not permitted on the parasail or the boat.

- **What if the weather is bad?**
  - If weather conditions are unsafe, we will contact you to reschedule or provide a refund.
